notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.1
notes.content:
[b]New Feature[/b]
[list]
[*] Xbox Controller Support
[/list]

[b]Improvement[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed dash to a toggle system
[*] Enabled camera control with the mouse wheel
[/list]

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
[list]
[*] Arm filters aren't saved
[*] Arm output directions aren't saved
[*] Item generator selections aren't saved
[*] Unable to move after resuming from pause
[*] Arm speed may become slow
[*] Fixed a miscalculation in packaged
[/list]
